column1: # AUTHORED 2026-11-13. Canonical wheat fungal pathogens that PHI-base does NOT curate with a
# Triticum host, admitted from authoritative wheat-disease references. PHI-base is a molecular
# database (experimentally verified virulence genes), so it misses well-established field
# diseases nobody has done gene-function work on. This file is the reproducible patch: one row
# per species, the named wheat disease it causes, and the citation that evidences it.
# screen_pathogens.py UNIONS this into is_wheat_pathogen (and is_plant_pathogen) and tags
# wheat_pathogen_source so every label traces to either PHI-base or a named reference here.
# ADMISSION RULE: the species must cause a NAMED disease of wheat (Triticum) documented in a
# peer-reviewed review or the APS disease compendium. ncbi_taxid is resolved to SPECIES rank
# (the join is species-level). Do not add a species already carried by PHI-base; this file is
# for the gaps only. No database swap recovers these -- see the memory note on the exhausted
# PHI-base-alternative search (CABI paywalled, EPPO quarantine-only, Zenodo host-range DB is
